# must-get-wins-when-not-all-fit

Synthetic. A late start (16:00) and an 18:00 latest finish, back home. Bognor (19 minutes away) and
Pulborough (45 minutes away) each fit alone (Pulborough: 16:45 arrive, 17:05 depart, 17:50 home)
but not together (either order returns after 18:00). Pulborough is "must get", so the objective's
first term (most must-get stops) picks it over the nearer Bognor, which alone would cost less
driving. Bognor is unassigned with reason `latest_finish`.
